name: High contrast (colour-vision safe)
description: Same type scale as the reference theme, different palette. Section colour is the sheet's main category cue, and under red-green colour blindness the reference palette collapses: blue and purple are near-identical under both deuteranopia and protanopia (worst-case separation 0.019), and green sits next to orange and red. These five maximise the minimum pairwise separation under simulated deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia, subject to at least 4.6:1 contrast on white -- which a 0.92pt rule and 5.5pt bold type need. Worst-case separation is 0.148, roughly eight times better. The cost is semantic: green cannot coexist safely with red, so transport and outdoors lose it. Headings keep their icons and titles, which carry the category regardless of colour.
